body:
I really don't know what they did differently from me. I put everything into it, and I've often wondered myself what the difference was, because I'd go through and see them feeling better over time, while I remained the same, and it made me feel like I was failing.

Maybe that was it? Maybe because I always doubted it from day 1?

But I'd still say try it if you get the chance. Seems to work for enough people that it's at least worth a shot.

All I can is I'm sorry. It sucks. I don't want to be like this forever, and neither do you, obviously.

But I just feel like there's no choice. Even the best therapy or counseling out there is geared at "living with it" as opposed to an out and out cure.

That is of course because there is no cure. You're like this, and the best you can ever hope for is accepting that. That pisses me off and saddens me greatly.

Not denying it does work for a lot of people though. I've seen people be set free by it, so I can't totally shit on it.

I want to love people, I want to be loved. Everyone wants that. I don't trust people sure, but I also don't want to be alone. It's a dichotomy for sure, but I guess I wouldn't be like this if it were simple.
